title: architect check
summary: architect check now holds a project to five parts: no blanks left, tsc clean, the architect lint rules clean, generated/ exactly what the blueprint renders, and the ratchets it still allows. Each finding names its file, line and rule. The rules run through real oxlint with the project's model passed in: no declared name as a string, a log before every refusal, only declared errors, no wall clock or raw sleep, and every handler file belonging to an operation.
proves: Four planted fixtures each make architect check exit 1 naming the file: an edited output, a name as a string, an undeclared error and a refusal with no log. Clean acme passes with ratchets 0.
